identity_policy: Preserve original canonical identities and exact variants; only strip a trailing slash from appended document URLs. denominator_boundary: 108 retained intake items plus URLs in source-evidence-graph, reference-review and second-brain-contract; source-check-workflow adds claim checks on an existing identity (its invented negative-control URL is excluded). This is not all historical project sources. Two older report spans reconcile transfer pointers only; their other outgoing URLs are not enumerated. Adaptive review adds no public URLs. Concurrent worker documents are not implicitly included.
